title: Sustainability Audit for Singapore's F1 Grand Prix and Other Events
what_it_is: Sustainability Audit for Singapore's F1 Grand Prix and Other Events

sections.label: F1 Singapore Grand Prix carbon footprint
sections.summary: The Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix's carbon footprint was first measured in 2022, with energy use at 96.1% of emissions, published by Singapore GP Pte Ltd on 8 September 2023.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix's carbon footprint was measured for the first time in 2022.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Energy use made up the majority of emissions at 96.1%, while the remaining 3.9% were Scope 3 emissions from transport, waste and water.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: These findings were published in the Environmental, Social and Governance report by the race promoter, Singapore GP Pte Ltd or SGP on 8 September 2023.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: A similar audit will be conducted for the race this year.

sections.label: Race and MICE sustainability targets
sections.summary: Singapore GP Pte Ltd aims to halve race energy emissions by 2028 and switched to LED track lighting, while STB and SACEOS will track MICE waste and carbon emissions from this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: SGP aims to halve the energy emissions from the race by 2028.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The race promoter has also switched to energy-efficient LED track lightings which reduces electricity use by at least 30% compared to the previous metal-halide bulbs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: For the MICE industry, the Singapore Tourism Board (STB) 	and Singapore Association of Convention and Exhibition Organisers and Suppliers (SACEOS) are working with event organisers to start tracking the industry’s waste and carbon emissions from this year onwards.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: This is one of the targets that we have set under the MICE Sustainability Roadmap that was launched last year.
